abstract_level_only.cite: A. Michaeli, 'Elimination of infinities in equivalent edge currents, Part I: Fringe current components', IEEE TAP 34(7):912-918, 1986
abstract_level_only.status: full text NOT obtained; abstract retrieved verbatim
abstract_level_only.abstract_verbatim: New expressions are derived for the fringe current components of the equivalent edge currents. They are obtained by asymptotic endpoint evaluation of the fringe current radiation integral over the 'ray coordinate' measured along the diffracted ray grazing the surface of the local wedge. The resulting expressions, unlike the previous ones, are finite for all aspects of illumination and observation, except for the special case where the direction of observation is the continuation of a glancing incident ray propagating 'inwards' with respect to the wedge surface (the Ufimtsev singularity).
abstract_level_only.why_it_matters: confirms the strip direction u-hat is the GRAZING DIFFRACTED RAY, which is what Oztuerk (3.30) cos(gamma) = sin(b')sin(b)cos(phi) + cos(b')cos(b) encodes (note the PLUS sign; the other Keller-cone/face intersection root, used in the 1984-style derivation, carries a minus). Our doc sections 2.1 and 4.1 describe the strip as 'the intersection of the Keller cone and the wedge face' (Gao's wording) without saying WHICH of the two intersection rays. That is imprecise, though the implemented algebra picks the right one automatically.

abstract_level_only.cite: E. F. Knott, 'The relationship between Mitzner's ILDC and Michaeli's equivalent currents', IEEE TAP 33(1):112-114, 1985
abstract_level_only.status: full text NOT obtained; abstract retrieved verbatim
abstract_level_only.abstract_verbatim: Michaeli recently derived a set of equivalent edge currents for scattering directions not on the Keller cone. Some years ago, Mitzner developed his incremental length diffraction coefficient (ILDC) for the same purpose. It is shown that Michaeli's results relate to Mitzner's for arbitrary directions in identically the way Keller's relate to Ufimtsev's for directions on the Keller cone.
abstract_level_only.note: This relates Mitzner's ILDC to MICHAELI 1984 (total-current EEC), not to Michaeli 1986. Our doc section 2.3 states the same relation but then slides to 'therefore (a) and (b) are the same thing, only different algebra'. That slide is stronger than the abstract supports.

abstract_level_only.cite: K. M. Mitzner, 'Incremental Length Diffraction Coefficients', Northrop Corp. AFAL-TR-73-296, Apr. 1974
abstract_level_only.status: NOT obtained. Still the one unfilled hole in the ILDC chain.

branch_question_resolved.concern: a = arccos(mu) is complex when |mu| > 1; Johansen eq (8) fixes a specific square-root branch that we could not read.
branch_question_resolved.resolution: moot. mu = (cos(gamma) - cos^2(beta0))/sin^2(beta0) and cos(gamma) <= 1, so mu <= 1 identically. Only mu < -1 is reachable, and there our _arccos_c agrees with numpy's principal arccos to 1e-14. Verified numerically at mu = -1, -3, -50.
branch_question_resolved.corollary: mu -> 1 (a -> 0) is exactly the Ufimtsev-singularity boundary named in Michaeli's abstract and in Johansen section II.

is_it_mitzner_ildc.verdict: Equivalent physics, NOT the same algebra. Do not write 'Mitzner ILDC'.
is_it_mitzner_ildc.reason: Knott 1985 equates Mitzner's ILDC with Michaeli 1984 minus the PO part. Michaeli 1986 is a LATER, DIFFERENT closed form obtained by integrating along the grazing diffracted ray specifically to remove infinities the earlier forms had. Johansen lists Ufimtsev's elementary edge waves [2], Mitzner's ILDC [3], Michaeli's EECs [4][5][6] and Shore-Yaghjian [7][8] as four separate closed forms for the same untruncated quantity, and then says he uses Michaeli's. Since we never read Mitzner, claiming numerical identity with Mitzner is unverified.

q2_did_we_do_gao_truncated_wedge.verdict: NO. We implemented only the untruncated half of it. The truncation is 100% absent, not approximated.

what_TW_actually_is.structure: Johansen 1996 eq (3): M_T = M_UT - M_cor and I_T = I_UT - I_cor.
what_TW_actually_is.M_UT_I_UT: Johansen eqs (4),(5) = Michaeli 1986 (4)-(7). >>> THIS IS WHAT WE IMPLEMENTED, exactly. <<<
what_TW_actually_is.M_cor_I_cor: Johansen eqs (9),(10) with the strip integral (11) L^A_{x,z} = int_{l^A}^{inf} J^{fw,A}_{x,z} exp(j k u s_hat . u_hat^A) du, asymptotically evaluated in his eqs (21),(22). >>> ABSENT FROM OUR CODE. <<<
what_TW_actually_is.geometric_meaning: the incremental strip is cut at the far (trailing) boundary of the wedge face; l^A is the physical strip length from the leading edge along u_hat^A, and L = k*l^A*sin^2(beta0) is the dimensionless strip-length parameter.
what_it_needs_that_we_never_compute: l^A per edge segment per aspect angle: the ray-march distance from the edge point along the grazing-diffracted-ray direction to where the face ends. Our extract_edges stores no face-extent information at all.
the Fresnel/transition function F() appearing in Johansen (21)/(22).
a second, independent strip and correction for face B.

why_this_is_not_a_small_omission_for_us.literature_anchor_1: Johansen section IV, PEC triangular cylinder of side 2*lambda (a few-lambda target, our size class), TE plane wave, bistatic: 'It is seen that the untruncated EEC's yield a poor approximation to the exact scattered FW field: the Ufimtsev singularity occurs for phi = 60 deg and the field is discontinuous across the current layers located at phi = 120, 180, 240, and 360 deg.' Read off his Fig. 4: the untruncated curve spikes to about +27 dB where the MFIE-minus-PO reference is about -5 dB, i.e. a ~30 dB error at the singularity, with several-dB errors and false lobes elsewhere.
why_this_is_not_a_small_omission_for_us.literature_anchor_2: Johansen's own summary of what truncation buys physically: 'the truncated EEC's only take into account part of the second-order edge diffraction because the FW current exited at the trailing edge is neglected.' Therefore omitting TW == omitting part of the second-order edge diffraction, and second-order is exactly what Oztuerk p.44 and Breinbjerg 1992 say grows relatively larger as the plate shrinks.
why_this_is_not_a_small_omission_for_us.scope_caveat_in_our_favour: Johansen's demonstration is BISTATIC over the full 360 deg. Our production use is monostatic backscatter. The Ufimtsev singularity (mu=1 AND phi0=pi simultaneously) is generically not on the monostatic locus, and the current-layer discontinuities are a bistatic-sweep artefact. So the 30 dB number is an upper bound for the wrong geometry and must NOT be quoted as our error bar. But the finite-face (trailing-edge) part of the truncation error has no such escape and is unbounded by anything we have measured.

q2_did_we_do_gao_truncated_wedge.our_doc_argument_for_skipping_TW_is_part: docs/PTD_ILDC_FORMULATION.md section 4.4 justifies skipping TW with 'in monostatic the untruncated EEC already has no singularity'. That conflates two different things. Truncation exists (i) to kill the Ufimtsev singularity and layer discontinuities AND (ii) to represent a physically finite face. Only (i) is helped by going monostatic. (ii) is untouched and is the one that bites at few-lambda.

q3_honest_name.one_line: First-order PTD fringe-wave correction computed with Michaeli's UNTRUNCATED equivalent edge currents (PTD-EEC), integrated analytically along straight edge segments.
q3_honest_name.korean_one_line: 1차 PTD 프린지파 보정 — Michaeli 의 비절단(untruncated) 등가모서리전류(PTD-EEC), 직선 조각 해석적 선적분.
why_these_words: 'untruncated EEC' is not our coinage: it is Johansen 1996's own term for exactly the quantity his eqs (4),(5) define and that we reproduce to 6e-12.
'PTD-EEC' is Oztuerk 2002's and Albayrak 2005's term for the same object.
'first order' is required because second-order edge-to-edge diffraction, corner diffraction and creeping waves are all zero in our code.

names_that_would_be_overclaims.TW-ILDC: FALSE. Missing the entire correction EEC, which is what the 'TW' means.
names_that_would_be_overclaims.ILDC: MISLEADING. In the SBR literature ILDC almost always means Mitzner's original or Gao's TW-ILDC. We implemented neither closed form.
names_that_would_be_overclaims.'Gao's method' / 'Gao 2012 edge term': FALSE. Gao's edge term is Johansen's truncated EEC. Ours is the untruncated one Johansen wrote his paper to replace.
names_that_would_be_overclaims.'PTD': acceptable as a family name only, and only with 'first order, untruncated' attached.
names_that_would_be_overclaims.'1차 등가모서리전류 근사': acceptable Korean shorthand but it undersells the provenance; prefer '1차 비절단 Michaeli PTD-EEC' so the missing piece is named.

q4_how_to_cite.english_method_sentence: The fringe-wave (non-uniform current) contribution is added to the physical-optics surface integral as a first-order physical theory of diffraction correction, using Michaeli's closed-form equivalent edge currents for an untruncated incremental wedge strip [Michaeli 1986], in the form tabulated by Oztuerk [Oztuerk 2002, eqs. (3.23)-(3.32)]. The correction (truncated-strip) equivalent edge currents of Johansen [Johansen 1996], which Gao et al. term TW-ILDCs [Gao 2012], are NOT included; our edge term is therefore the untruncated half of that formulation. Second-order edge, corner and creeping-wave contributions are likewise omitted.
q4_how_to_cite.english_limitation_sentence: Because the incremental strip is taken to be infinite, the trailing-edge truncation that Johansen shows to be necessary for few-wavelength faces is absent, and part of the second-order edge diffraction is therefore missing; this is the dominant known systematic error of our edge term for drone-scale scatterers.
q4_how_to_cite.korean_method_sentence: PO 면적분에 Ufimtsev 의 비균일(프린지) 전류 기여를 1차 PTD 보정으로 더한다. 계수는 Michaeli 의 비절단(untruncated) 증분 쐐기 스트립 등가모서리전류 닫힌형[Michaeli 1986]을 Oztuerk[2002, (3.23)-(3.32)] 의 표기로 구현한 것이다. Johansen[1996]의 절단(correction) EEC — Gao 등[2012]이 TW-ILDC 라 부르는 것 — 은 포함하지 않았다. 즉 우리 모서리항은 그 정식화의 비절단 절반이다.
q4_how_to_cite.korean_limitation_sentence: 증분 스트립을 무한으로 두었기 때문에, Johansen 이 few-λ 면에서 필요하다고 보인 후연(trailing edge) 절단이 빠져 있고 그만큼 2차 모서리회절의 일부가 누락된다. 드론 체급 표적에서 우리 모서리항의 최대 계통오차원이다.

gaps_vs_literature.literature: Ufimtsev 1962 p.28 (f,g and f0,g0 diverge on the reflection boundary while f1,g1 stay finite)
gaps_vs_literature.our_state: monostatic singular locus is cos(phi') = cot^2(beta). For beta = 90 deg (edge perpendicular to the line of sight -- the on-cone edges that section 6.2 says DOMINATE) this is phi' = 90 deg exactly, i.e. face-normal specular. Measured: at exact specular the raw kernel returns |Z I^f| ~ 1.7e31 and |M^f| ~ 6.4e33; the symmetric phi' +- 5e-3 rad average returns Z I^f = -0.015916j, M^f = -5.995868j against a delta->0 limit of -0.015916j / -5.995818j, i.e. ~1e-5 relative.
gaps_vs_literature.consequence: acceptable accuracy today (1e-5), but it is an undeclared O(delta^2) approximation sitting on the specular ray of every flat metal face, and the failure mode if delta is ever reduced is catastrophic (double-precision cancellation), which the doc itself documents in sec. 3.6.

The two-face composition, the U(pi-phi') illumination step, the mu and arccos definitions and the -2j cot(beta0)Hz0/(kN sin beta0) tail all match the source term by term.
The complex-arccos branch worry is resolved: mu <= 1 identically, so the ambiguous branch is unreachable.
The NOT_IMPLEMENTED / APPROXIMATIONS lists shipped in the module are accurate. Nothing absent is being passed off as present.
No report, notebook or slide deck in the repository claims 'we implemented TW-ILDC'. The overclaim exists only in the filename PTD_ILDC_FORMULATION.md and one RESUME.md work-item label.
single_most_important_correction: Stop describing this work with the string 'TW-ILDC'. Gao's TW-ILDC = Johansen's truncated EEC = untruncated EEC minus correction EEC. We built the untruncated EEC and nothing else. The correct, defensible, still-respectable name is 'first-order PTD fringe-wave correction using Michaeli's untruncated equivalent edge currents (PTD-EEC)'.
